body.subject: Git lane: the landed target is published to the declared remote, and a refused push is named

items.change: push_git(repo, branch, remote) pushes that branch to that remote and answers the push's own exit code and output, so a refused push (a non-fast-forward is the common one) is the caller's to name and is never read as a published landing. The module header states publication as the step after the landing.
items.evidence: land checks: all green - case L proves the landed target reaches a bare remote at the branch tip, and that a remote moved independently makes the next push fail rather than pass as published

items.change: carries the lane's two delivered commits the reboot left unlanded: 9fb08b9b (the checked landing drops every added path the repository's own ignore rules exclude and names the drop on the candidate message) and 0e41640a (the module header states that judgement).

carriedForward: push_git has no caller in the tree yet: the coordinator has no publish verb, so publication is a module primitive with its native proof only, the same shape land_checked had before the coordinator's land-checked command.

The bend2 Python suite (check-native.sh: unittest discover over bend2/test, then mcp-root and end-to-end) was not run: the root's instruction forbids a whole or near-whole suite outside swarm integrate. The landing gate of swarm integrate is the run that judges it.

bend2/scripts/run-checks.mjs was not run here: neither node_modules/.bend/bin/bend nor .bend/bin/bend exists in this checkout, and running it would install the toolchain into the tree. The direct bend commands above are the reported verification.
